Strategy: Take the loosest bin whose residual is at most twice the item, so the placement leaves room for at most one more same-size item; if no bin qualifies, fall back to Best Fit. It may help by using loose bins without leaving oversized leftovers, but may fail when no bin is within twice the item.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(r if r <= 2 * item else -(r - item) - 1000) for r in bins]
```
